none: PAS FindID 996173: Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine,
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, dating to the period c. AD 330-335 (Reece period 17). Victory standing left on prow holding shield and sceptre. Unclear mint. Clipped and worn. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: CON[STAN-TINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory standing left on prow holding shield and sceptre. Reverse inscription: Diameter: 12.20 mm; Thickness: 1.42 mm; Weight: 0.80g
